verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a datacenter GPU accelerator with no end-user interface where a built-in AI assistant could live, so delegating tasks to an in-product assistant does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product or its first-party software shipping such an assistant, so the exception does not apply. The 'AI-native' Spur job scheduler is a Slurm-compatible scheduler, not an assistant users can delegate tasks to.
